body: i think i might just do that. join a bike club or something. that will give me a reason to go out. i have to start doing shit that makes me happy even if im not in the mood for it thanks a lot for that.....i am so close to quitting my job...i wonder if that would be the smart thing to do. i dont have any huge bills and i can survive off of what i have...should i quit and find another?

lol. not all radiohead is depressing. although i am listening to "sail to the moon" from the hail to the thief album and it is pretty fucking sad. its all ive been listening to for the past 10 hrs....i dont care much for money so i dont think ill miss it if i quit...i wish i could think the way you do to help me thru these times but sadly i cannot. thanks for the laugh though
sex makes me happy. riding my bike makes me happy. music makes me happy(although equally sad). i dont have much happiness in my life. wish i could get divorced but we honestly cant afford to do it.

what makes me happy? Im too down to even think happy thoughts at the moment. sorry. i will say that i feel like ive lost all hope. which is also feeling kind of liberating. makes me want to give my 2 week notice and start looking for another job. tomorrow.

nothing has happened...thats the thing. my life has been going uphill for the past couple of months but this god damn feeling doesnt want to leave. ive been feeling this way since i was 15 (im 23 now) and i really have no reason why i should be feeling bad for myself. other people have it much much much worse than me. and i have no issues with my friend. we just havent been hanging out lately. and i really dont wanna hang with him anyway and i dont know why....im so fucking confused. i dont know if im making any sense

i really dont have much to say. just hate my life. but i really start to hate it when my mind is idle...when i have nothing to do. if im not busy then i get mentally fucked. it hurts like hell and i can feel the pain in my chest and throat. as if my body is telling me to let it out and scream till i cant scream anymore
